source: due2-native: an absolute deadline on a day that does not exist (#125)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl, which checks a literal's datatype but not whether its lexical form names a value; the rejection is due2's. The literal matches the dateTime shape that due2-deadline-no-timezone tests, so only a value check catches it. clingo-i declines the policy with the reason `duty: deadline not comparable` (spikes/clingo-i/lp/duty.lp).

expected_rejection.why: ex:pay's dprod:deadline "2026-02-30T12:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime names no instant, since February has no 30th (XSD 1.1 Part 2 §3.3.7). An absolute deadline is an xsd:dateTime (due2-profiles.md §7), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2.
